_comment: Single source of truth for the release family. Every release script (build_release.py,
make_model_cards.py, hf_upload.py, upload_datasets.py) iterates this list.
FINAL epoch ships (checkpoint_last, EMA weights; calibration.json is fitted on it).
Released family = HICO-DET 0.05 + source-aware negative masking recipe on the full pack.
The *-zeroshot entries are the same recipe with no HICO-DET in the mixture: the paper's
zero-shot rows. run_dir names the training run under $RA_RUNS/train on the training machine;
hf_repo is where the weights are published.

models.notes: official ViT-S/16; CPU/laptop pick (backbone dominates CPU time)

gate.gates: G1 OVS-F1>=zeroshot-0.003, G2 OVS-mR same, G3 HICO F1@50>=0.30, G4 A6>=0.349
